analyst_view.overall: Early view: Lille host Bayern Munich in the Champions League on the Wednesday before this trip, so Davide Ancelotti may rotate. Le Mans (15th) have taken points in four of their five home games and outshot Monaco 19-5 in a 1-1 draw, while Lille have the best defence in the league (7 conceded).

goals.text: The numbers say 2.5 goals. I lean lower: Lille concede 0.7 a game and score only 1.4, and Le Mans have scored 12 in 10. A rotated Lille three days after Bayern is more likely to grind out a narrow result than open up.

corners.text: The numbers say 8.2 corners. I lean lower: Le Mans average 3.0 corners a game (17th) and Lille 3.6 (14th). Le Mans did win eight against Monaco, so seven or eight rather than a very low number.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.1 cards. I lean higher: Le Mans are 3rd for fouls (14.8 a game) and made 16 against Monaco, and Lille made 15 fouls with three yellows at Rennes. Expect a scrappy, physical game.

shots.text: The numbers say 22.6 shots. Season averages (Le Mans 10.7, Lille 11.4) back that up and Le Mans shoot more at home, so I stay with it. Lille are efficient rather than high-volume.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 7.8 shots on target. That looks fair: Le Mans manage 3.6 on target a game and Lille 5.0, and Lille's defence keeps opponents to poor chances. No reason to move it before team news.
